questions: How is the v2 saved mmap base chosen?
Is there an existing per-module mmap outcome trace/runtime environment switch?

address_selection.hash_input: Lean module Name; CompactedRegion.save calls this argument key
address_selection.continuation: With prev, reuse the prior Compactor. The v2 header records compactor.base_addr() plus current aligned file_offset, supporting multiple parts without re-serializing shared objects.
address_selection.ordinary_module_export: saveModuleData starts with prev = none; saveModuleDataParts starts none and chains it across module parts.

fallback.linux: When LEAN_MMAP is compiled in, mmap requests the saved address with MAP_PRIVATE and MAP_FIXED_NOREPLACE when available. A failed mapping, or a returned address unequal to the saved address, leaves buffer null; any wrong-address mapping is unmapped. The null-buffer path mallocs and readn's the full file.
possible_source_supported_causes: Requested virtual address range already occupied.
Requested address/range incompatible with the process/platform mapping constraints.
Other OS mapping failure, treated identically by this code.
fallback.aslr: ASLR does not choose the saved module address. Inference: ASLR can affect whether other existing process mappings occupy that deterministic requested range; the branch itself does not report the failure cause.
fallback.build_switch: MMAP is a CMake build option, default ON, defining LEAN_MMAP. A build without it takes the full-file fallback; it is not a runtime environment variable.
not_claimed: No actual mapping outcomes for the failed BothLong process were measured.
No timeout cause or successful kernel completion follows.

observability.per_module_builtin_trace: No per-module mmap success/fallback trace or runtime environment-variable hook exists in the fully inspected pinned loader and immediate import call sites. Loader code contains no getenv/log/printf/fprintf/cout/cerr trace branch for these outcomes.
observability.existing_cli: --stats invokes Environment.displayStats and prints aggregate number of imported modules, number of memory-mapped modules, and logical imported byte total.
observability.cli_timing: The frontend calls displayStats only after runAndReport and waitForFinalCmdState?, so it is not a flushed per-module progress diagnostic for an import-phase timeout.
observability.existing_data: Each loaded CompactedRegion already records filePath, size and isMemoryMapped, collected in env.header.regions. These fields can describe outcome after loading, but there is no current per-module streaming logger in this path.

scope: Review files only; no .olean rewriting, Lean/controller/workflow edits, runtime changes, CI runs or proof bypass.
